name: Kuru · Pāṇḍava line
note: Sons of Pāṇḍu and their children.

name: Kuru · Kaurava line
note: Sons of Dhṛtarāṣṭra. A sibling pattern to the Pāṇḍava line: both are Kurus.

name: Yādava
note: The Vṛṣṇi-Yādavas of Mathurā and Dvārakā.

name: Gāndhāra
note: The house of Subala, Gāndhārī’s father.

name: Aṅga · Sūta
note: Karṇa: raised by the charioteer Adhiratha, made king of Aṅga. (His birth to Kuntī is a secret the story keeps until after his death.)
